name: git-state-evidence-guard
description: Validates an explicit HEAD, branch, and clean-worktree declaration at Stop.

interface.shortDescription: Validate explicit Git state evidence at Stop.
interface.longDescription: Checks a git-state-evidence/v1 block against the current repository HEAD, branch or detached state, and staged, unstaged, and untracked changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Verify the declared Git state against the current workspace.
